paragraphs.text: Tusk is an elephant performer alongside Whiskers the mouse performer for Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Weighing in at a combined thirteen thousand pounds and two ounces, Tusk and Whiskers perform with great coordination and flair. Originally hired as separate performers, the two became a pair after a show where Myra threw multiple acts together. They found an affinity to working with one another and crafted a show that became the number-one hit show in the park.
